# Coder Kids

> Coder Kids provides online coding education and game design instruction for youth through private tutoring, camps, and scholarship programs.

Coder Kids specializes in teaching programming languages like Python, Java, C++, and JavaScript, alongside game design platforms including Roblox, Unity, and Minecraft. The platform offers personalized instruction through private lessons and makes coding education accessible through financial aid initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Java
- C++
- JavaScript
- Roblox
- Game Design
- Private Lessons
- Online Tutoring
- Youth Education
- Scholarships
- Financial Aid
- Unity Game Engine
- Scratch
- Coding Instruction
- Summer Camps

## Core Programs

- [Private Lessons](https://privatelessons.coderkids.com): Online 1-on-1 tutoring in Python, Java, C++, Roblox game design, and other programming languages with personalized instruction

## Financial Support

- [Scholarships](https://scholarships.coderkids.com): Scholarship and financial aid program for Coder Kids students to make coding education more accessible
